reviewed_by: Automated source-semantic review by the delegated coding agent against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 (MCP), Radare2 6.2.0, angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast and an ad-hoc retail-ESIL/host-built differential
review_basis: The working-tree revision of engine/src/retail/core/app_startup_natives.cpp read for this report hashes to 337c5d5726e7d7ddc366dcece75a990ccdf7b7d436a8cf15a930b12e911dba3a and its header hashes to 790a989331d01be1a96fe9e7136374f2f524d6f5f216a9f3e1a534c0ad026b50. The retail body was disassembled and decompiled through the live Binary Ninja MCP view, recovered independently with Radare2 6.2.0 and angr CFGFast at the exact entry, and the candidate function was exercised against the retail bytes in Radare2 ESIL for ten 32-bit values.

binary_ninja.result: range 0x0048F080-0x0048F086 (6 bytes), 1 basic block, 0 incoming/outgoing edges inside the function, 0 callees; prototype int32_t() with the default cdecl convention; disassembly mov eax,dword [0x5c8bc8]; retn; HLIL return g_5c8bc8; memory read a1c88b5c00c390909090909090909090; single caller callsite 0x0048F369 in function 0x0048F360.

radare2.result: function size 6, nbbs 1, ninstrs 2, edges 0, calltype cdecl, nargs 0, indegree 1, outdegree 0; bytes a1c88b5c00c3; axt reports the only call site 0x48f369 (caller fcn.0048f360), the data read at 0x48f080 and the only data write to 0x005c8bc8 at 0x48f0c4.

angr.result: exact entry 0x0048F080 recovered; function_entry 0x0048F080, block_count 1, nodes ['0x0048F080'], edges [], returning true, has_unresolved_jumps false, result pass; binary SHA-256 dea34892... loaded at mapped base 0x400000 with bits 32.

host_differential.tool: Radare2 6.2.0 ESIL (retail bytes) versus a host-built translation unit (candidate), ad-hoc script at /tmp/taskb_getters.py
host_differential.result: Ten 32-bit values (0, 1, 0x1000, 0x400000, 0x5C8BD4, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xDEADBEEF, 0xFFFFFFFF) were seeded at retail 0x005C8BC8, the retail getter was executed from 0x0048F080, and the candidate was called with CommandLine seeded to the same bits. All ten returned the seeded value, left the global unchanged and did not modify the InstanceHandle/AppTitle sibling globals; 10/10 matched.
host_differential.durability: This is a one-off command, not a committed runner case in scripts/native_diff_runner.py; the runner's committed cases cover 0x0048F0C0 and 0x0048F0D0 only.

observed_semantics.return_value: EAX receives the 32-bit dword loaded from 0x005C8BC8 on the only path

candidate_semantics.function: char const* IGI_RETAIL_CDECL GetRetailCommandLine() { return CommandLine; }
candidate_semantics.behavior: No arguments. One 4-byte load of the CommandLine global into EAX followed by a return. No branch, call, arithmetic, floating-point operation or write.

global.written_by: StoreCommandLine (0x0048F0C0 candidate), matching retail's only writer at 0x0048F0C4

object.function_sha_shape: GetRetailCommandLine is 6 bytes: a1 <dir32 .bss+8>; c3, the same 6-byte load/return shape as retail

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja, Radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast each recover exactly one function at 0x0048F080 spanning 6 bytes with 2 instructions, one basic block and no edges. The current translation unit defines exactly one function for this address, GetRetailCommandLine returning the CommandLine global.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail body reads no argument slot and Binary Ninja gives it the cdecl no-argument prototype int32_t(); Radare2 reports nargs 0. The candidate declares char const* __cdecl(void). The adapted pointer return type is the recorded ABI adaptation; the argument contract (none) is identical.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The only retail constant is the absolute global address 0x005C8BC8 encoded in the moffs load a1c88b5c00. There is no scaling, arithmetic or index computation. The candidate body contains no source constant; the load address is the linker relocation of the CommandLine symbol at .bss+8 in the fresh object.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail performs exactly one 4-byte read from 0x005C8BC8 and writes nothing. The candidate performs exactly one 4-byte read of the 4-byte global CommandLine and writes nothing; the fresh -O3 object encodes it as `mov <dir32 .bss+8>,%eax`, the same width and kind. The retail-to-candidate global mapping is recorded in the manifest, and the host differential confirmed the read returns the seeded dword.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail has no call instructions and no side effects: it only reads 0x005C8BC8. The candidate calls nothing and writes nothing; the host differential re-read the global after the call and found it unchanged, and the sibling InstanceHandle and AppTitle globals unchanged.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail has one basic block, one return and no error branch; EAX is the loaded dword. The candidate likewise has one return path returning the loaded global. In the ad-hoc differential all ten 32-bit values, including 0x00000000, 0x80000000 and 0xFFFFFFFF, were returned bit-for-bit by both the retail ESIL execution and the host-built candidate.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The body performs no floating-point load, store or arithmetic and reads no FPU state.

limitations: The reviewed scope is the single getter path; the function has no alternate or error path.

CFG evidence is retail-image structure only: Binary Ninja and Radare2 independently recover the same one-block retail graph, and cfg_similarity 1.0 measures their agreement, not candidate-versus-retail similarity.

Candidate structural equivalence rests on the identical one-block load/return shape, the fresh -O3 object and the ten-case retail-ESIL/host differential, not on a paired runtime capture. A paired typed Frida capture of retail igi.exe and the staged candidate is outstanding.
The ten-case host differential is an ad-hoc command, not a committed case in scripts/native_diff_runner.py; only 0x0048F0C0 and 0x0048F0D0 have committed runner cases.
The candidate reads its own mapped 4-byte global rather than retail 0x005C8BC8; this review does not establish process-wide memory-layout equivalence.

The only direct caller 0x0048F360 was not reconstructed or compared; the claim that it consumes the return value as a command-line string rests on Binary Ninja/Radare2 disassembly of the retail caller, not on candidate code.
